audience: teams who send appointment reminders and other text messages with smsmode

useCases.title: Check your SMS credit balance
useCases.text: The AI reads the credit balance with amount, currency and payment type, and the monthly limit and consumption of the organisation.

useCases.title: See how many texts were sent and what they cost
useCases.text: The AI reads sent-message counts and money spent per month or per day, for all channels or one channel. It can break a record down by country or network.

useCases.title: Check whether messages were delivered
useCases.text: The AI lists sent and received messages with recipient, text and delivery status, including the cause of a failure. It reads one message in full.

useCases.title: Review SMS campaigns and delivery counts
useCases.text: The AI lists campaigns with status, quantity and delivery counts per status, and reads one campaign. Campaigns are read only.

useCases.title: Check channels, sender IDs and limits
useCases.text: The AI lists the SMS and RCS channels with flow, default sender, authorized sender IDs and daily and monthly limits.

useCases.title: Send a text, or cancel one that is still scheduled
useCases.text: The AI sends one SMS to 1 to 10 recipients now or at a set time. It can cancel a message that is still scheduled.
